text:
Senior Product Manager at Lumina Games, shaping immersive gaming experiences. Over seven years, I’ve focused on building products that balance creativity and precision.  

Agile/Scrum has been central to my approach. At Lumina, I led a cross-functional team to streamline workflows, reducing sprint cycles by 15% while maintaining quality. I also implemented Scrum practices for a mobile game launch, enabling faster feedback loops and a 20% improvement in feature delivery timelines.  

Roadmap planning has always been about aligning vision with execution. I once restructured a quarterly plan to prioritize player retention features, which contributed to a 12% increase in monthly active users. Another project involved balancing short-term goals with long-term innovation, ensuring the team stayed focused on both immediate wins and strategic growth.  

Stakeholder management requires listening and clarity. I’ve navigated complex needs by creating shared KPIs, which helped align marketing and engineering teams on a major update. Transparent communication has been key to keeping all parties informed and engaged.  

Leading a team of 8+ has meant fostering growth and accountability. I mentor junior managers and encourage collaborative problem-solving. Data tools like Tableau help translate insights into action, ensuring decisions are grounded in real-world trends.  

Gaming is about connecting people, and I’m committed to building experiences that inspire.
